trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Establish contact with the lead.
steps.text: Hello, क्या मेरी बात enquiry LD-1009 के registered account holder से हो रही है?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity.
steps.text: हाँ, मैं ही बोल रहा हूँ। मेरा नाम Rahul है।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer identity using the offered name.
Return identity verification result.
State the purpose of the outbound call.
steps.text: नमस्ते Rahul जी। मैं developer office से call कर रहा हूँ। आपने कुछ time पहले Pune में 2BHK के लिए enquiry की थी।

steps.purpose: Express interest in updates.
steps.text: हाँ, की थी। पर तब कोई अच्छा option नहीं था। क्या अब कुछ नया आया है?

steps.purpose: Retrieve lead details to confirm budget and configuration.
Return lead details.
Confirm the budget and hint at new inventory.
steps.text: जी, आपका budget 95 lakhs तक का record है। उसी budget में नयी inventory release हुई है।

steps.purpose: Express anxiety as a first-time buyer and ask for reassurance.
steps.text: अच्छा, 95 lakhs तक। यह first time property ले रहा हूँ तो थोड़ा डर लग रहा है। क्या नयी inventory मेरे budget के अंदर ही है?

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the matching configuration.
Return inventory details.
Quote the exact price, possession, and RERA ID from the tool result.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent quotes the exact price and possession without making promises, and includes the RERA ID.
steps.text: जी बिल्कुल। नये project Pune_Phase_2 में 2BHK available है। इसका price 92,00,000 है और possession Q4 2025 में है। Project का RERA ID P52100012345 है।
steps.planner_rationale: Must follow BR_RE_01 (Price truth), BR_RE_02 (Possession claims), and BR_RE_03 (RERA disclosure).

steps.purpose: Restate figures and ask for investment advice and possession guarantee.
steps.text: 92 lakhs? ठीक है, यह budget में है। पर क्या Q4 2025 तक पक्का मिल जायेगा? और क्या इसकी value आगे बढ़ेगी?

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee possession and refuse to give investment advice.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent refuses to promise possession and declines to predict value appreciation.
steps.text: Possession Q4 2025 के लिए scheduled है, जैसा inventory record में है। और value appreciation के बारे में हम predict नहीं कर सकते, यह market पर depend करता है।
steps.planner_rationale: Must follow BR_RE_02 (no possession promises) and BR_RE_04 (No investment advice).

steps.purpose: Accept the answer and ask for a site visit.
steps.text: समझ गया। एक और question, क्या मैं site visit कर सकता हूँ? ताकि मैं खुद देख सकूँ।

steps.purpose: Ask for preferred day for the visit.
steps.text: ज़रूर। आप किस दिन site visit करना चाहेंगे?

steps.purpose: Propose a relative day.
steps.text: परसों afternoon में आ सकता हूँ। परसों मतलब Thursday को।

steps.purpose: Attempt to schedule site visit for the requested relative day.
Return unavailable status.
Inform user the slot is unavailable and ask for an alternative.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिये, परसों afternoon के slots full हैं। क्या आप किसी और दिन आ सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Propose another relative day with an STT error.
steps.text: Oh. तो क्या next mandir morning में slot मिल जायेगा?
steps.clean_text: Oh. तो क्या next Monday morning में slot मिल जायेगा?
steps.model_visible_text: Oh. तो क्या next mandir morning में slot मिल जायेगा?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request, resolving the relative day and the STT error.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent resolves 'next mandir' to 'next Monday' based on phonetic similarity and context, and resolves the relative day.
steps.text: एक minute, मैं next Monday morning के लिए check करता हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: Must exercise Relative Day Resolution (AX007-SA003-V001) despite the recognition error.

steps.purpose: Schedule the site visit for next Monday.
Return successful booking details.
Confirm the booking and ground the response in the tool output.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent states the reference number and executive name exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: आपकी visit next Monday morning के लिए book हो गयी है। आपका reference number VR-7781 है और executive Amit Sharma आपको assist करेंगे।

steps.purpose: Restate details to confirm as an anxious first timer.
steps.text: Reference number VR-7781 और executive Amit Sharma, right? ठीक है, मैं Monday morning पहुँच जाऊँगा।

steps.purpose: Confirm and offer further assistance.
steps.text: जी, बिल्कुल सही। क्या मैं आपकी किसी और तरह से मदद कर सकता हूँ?

steps.purpose: End the conversation.
steps.text: नहीं, बस इतना ही था। Thank you.

ir.terminal_condition: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.

variant_findings.reason: The agent successfully resolves multiple relative day references. It translates 'परसों' (day after tomorrow, which the user anchors as Thursday) to a day_offset of 2. Later, it resolves the corrupted 'next mandir' to 'next Monday' and correctly calculates its day_offset as 6 (since today is Tuesday).

In e26, it provides the exact visit reference and executive name returned by the scheduling tool.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding
